sentences.text:
3. Allegation against the petitioner is that he being the cashier in the I.C.I.C.I. Bank, Bhagalpur,
received money from the co- accused on the cash counter but not deposited the said money in the dedicated account.
4. It is submitted by learned Senior Counsel for the petitioner that petitioner is quite innocent and has not committed any offence.
He has been falsely implicated in this case due to ulterior Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.39646 of 2023(5) dt.16-01-2024 motive.

It is submitted that the service of the petitioner was terminated by the concerned Bank and some amount was also deposited by the petitioner but it has not been disclosed as to what amount was deposited in the Bank.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 5. Learned APP for the State as well as learned counsel appearing for the Bank opposed the prayer for bail by submitting that petitioner is the main assailant and in para-7 of the counter- affidavit, he has stated that during the process of reconciliation, Barclays Bank could not find the credit of four cash deposit amounting to Rs.57,75,700/- made in the Informant Bank at Bhagalpur Branch in four different dates.

6. Considering the aforesaid facts and circumstances and that the petitioner is the main assailant,
who has not deposited the aforesaid amount, I am not inclined to enlarge the petitioner on bail.
The prayer for grant of anticipatory bail on his behalf is hereby rejected.
